title: Stadtturm Innsbruck
highlights: 51 Meter hoher historischer Wachturm aus der Gotik im Herzen der Altstadt
133 Stufen hinauf zur überdachten Aussichtsplattform auf 31 Metern Höhe
Spektakulärer 360-Grad-Panoramablick auf das Goldene Dachl und die Nordkette
Jahrhundertelang Sitz der Innsbrucker Turmwächter zur Feuer- und Gefahrenwarnung
kurzbeschreibung: The gothic Stadtturm Innsbruck offers a breathtaking panoramic view over the historic old town and the mountains after 133 steps.
beschreibung:
Historic Watchtower of the Provincial Capital

In the heart of the bustling Herzog-Friedrich-Strasse, the gothic Stadtturm Innsbruck rises 51 metres high. Built between 1442 and 1450 adjoining the Old City Hall, the tower symbolised the growing confidence of the Innsbruck citizenry.

Panoramic Views Over Rooftops and Mountain Peaks

Via a curved spiral staircase, visitors reach the viewing platform at a height of 31 metres. From here, guests enjoy an incomparable bird's-eye view of the Goldene Dachl, the winding alleyways of the old town, and the steeply rising Nordkette.
